description: A policy as it is shown to people - its text, its own revision and its status. Whichever system shows a policy publishes it, under its own domain; acknowledgments point at it with an external reference pinning its revision and content hash.

examples.body:
# Access control

Everyone signs in with SSO and a passkey.
examples.title: Access control

acknowledgment_from.description: Acknowledging this revision, or any from this one on, counts for this revision. Absent means only this revision's own acknowledgments count. At most revision.

id.description: Such as access-control, for references like policy:access-control.

label.description: The version's own name in its source, such as 2.0. revision is its number.

owner_role.description: When the role travels in the same bundle.

revision.description: The policy's own revision number, raised on every published change. Not the type's version.

source_fields.description: The source's own fields that no field here covers, under the source's names. Readers keep it and don't interpret it. Never a personal value that a field here would label.

statements.description: Its passages, when they travel in the same bundle.

title: policy
